capabilities: Convert clipboard text into a Markdown table
Convert selected aligned text into a Markdown table
Convert clipboard HTML tables as a fallback
Pad ragged rows and optionally add a row-number column
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true) because it reads the system clipboard; mobile may be considered later. README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes full Chinese documentation; suggests PKMer Market as an install mirror.
motivation: The author built it because hand-writing Markdown tables means memorizing boilerplate syntax that is "noisy, easy to break" and must be decided before the content is ready.
problem: Writing Markdown tables by hand requires typing pipe separators and a divider line, which is noisy, easy to break, and forces syntax decisions before content exists.
summary: Converts tab-, space-, or pipe-aligned plain text from the clipboard or a selection into clean Markdown tables.
